fields.name: meaning
fields.guidance: Clear English definition of this card single sense, without Chinese characters and without giving away the term.

fields.name: translation
fields.guidance: Concise Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) gloss of this card single sense, written the way a Taiwanese speaker would say it. Traditional characters and Taiwan vocabulary only; never a word-for-word rendering of meaning, never a semicolon-joined dictionary list of several senses.

fields.name: implications
fields.guidance: Prefer 3 to 6 zh-TW concept keywords (at most 4 characters each) naming the hidden concepts and usage contexts the term activates, for court the four items being 正義 公正 程序 法律. Use fewer when the sense is genuinely clear; never invent awkward concepts to meet a count. Never translations, synonyms, antonyms, descriptions, or sentences. Overlapping a correlation is expected: implications are Chinese concepts, correlations are English words.

fields.name: literal
fields.guidance: Word-for-word Traditional Chinese gloss of the whole expression, 灑出豆子 for spill the beans. Required for idioms and phrasal verbs, empty for plain literal senses, and never the idiomatic translation.

fields.name: typeLabel
fields.guidance: Space-separated labels chosen only from this list: {values}. Empty only when no label applies; no brackets.

fields.name: phonetic
fields.patternMessage: must be US IPA enclosed in slashes

fields.name: en
fields.guidance: Natural English sentence using this card sense of the term, ending in . ? or !; no Chinese; no markup except <b> around a collocation other than the term.

fields.name: zh
fields.guidance: Natural Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) translation of that same sense, keeping the sentence voice (a question stays a question).
